760730103.text: I felt stifled while I lived there, but now that I've left, I find myself missing it... This is the first time I've been so far from home.

760730104.text: I thought there would be plenty of fae living in other places too, like back home. Even Snezhnograd has its fair share of them.

760730105.text: But then I ended up in Nod-Krai and haven't even seen a single one of them. Paimon also said she isn't fae. Hmm... It's got nothing to do with the climate here, right...?

760730113.text: There's no snowstorms here, and you won't be left without options if you're caught without a stove in the wild.

760730114.text: Oh and, I even saw someone drinking liquor from Novokitezhgrad in Nod-Krai. We're known for our liquor industry as much as our mining industry, but still, seeing stuff from home makes me... sentimental?

760730107.text: Ah, him... He used to be the best and favorite student of my father's. I guess he's made a name for himself now that he's with the Fatui?

760730108.text: I used to admire him too. I wanted to be like him... but I guess no matter how hard I try, I can never beat him.

760730109.text: Hmm, I used to think he didn't care about me at all, but this time I could feel his hostility. I wonder why?

760730110.text: And that comment about me being "arrogant"... No idea where that came from.

760730112.text: Yeah! Until then, good luck to the both of us!
